title: The Seventh, concerning the Five Fathers
text:
⟨p.34⟩
7
— The Seventh: Concerning —
7 The Five Fathers 7
Again, while the Illuminator, our Father, the Apostle of
Truth, was sitting in the midst of his disciples, proclaiming
to them the Greatness of God — he spoke again to
them in this manner in his revelation, saying: 'There are five Fathers
in existence, who were called forth one from another, where one {5} forth
from another. The first Father is the Father of
Greatness, the glorious blessed one, who has no measure to his
Greatness, who is himself the first Only-Begotten, the
first eternal one, who exists with the five eternal Fathers,
who exists before all things that have come into being and
that shall come into being. He himself is the glorious Father. He emanated
three emanations from himself: the first is the Great
Spirit, the first one there, who came forth from the Father; she
manifested forth as first. The second is the Beloved of
the Lights, the Great Beloved who is glorious, the honored one,
who came forth from the Father, who has been revealed from him.
The third Father is the Third {20},
the first of all the counselors, {22}
⟨p.35⟩
The First Father has been revealed. This is the First Father:
the First Power, from whom the three great Powers came forth.
This is the First Father, the First Eternal One, the root
of all the lights, from whom the three emanations came forth
from him. They humbled the Darkness; they laid waste its pride-of-heart; they
gave kingship to themselves alone; they also gave kingship to the aeons.
The Second Father, who came forth from the First Father, is the Third
Ambassador, the Protomē of the King of the Lights.
He himself also called; he sent forth from himself three
Powers. The first is the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man,
perfect, who bears upward under all things, the great Pillar
of Praise, the great Omophoros, who bears up all the omopho-
phoroi. The second is Jesus the Radiance, who is glorious,
{0} through whom they give the eternal life. The third
is the Virgin of the Light, the Soph{1}a, who is glorious,
who steals away the heart of the {2}ons and the Powers by her image, perfect
in the pride-of-h{3}t of greatness.
The Third Father, who came forth from the Second Father — he
is Jesus the Radiance, who is glorious. He himself also called
three callings, after the likeness of the Second Father.
The first power that he called is the Min{4} of Light,
the father of all the apostles, the first of the {5}clesiae
{6}, whom Jesus has set before our likeness in the holy Chur-
ch.
The second power that Jesus cal-
{7}led is the {8}dge who judges all the souls
{9} men, with {10} tabernacle established in the air, under {11}
{12} the wheel {13} of the stars. The third Power is
the {14}outh, the great {15} of light. In his coun-
tenance are two faces in {16} gazing toward the heaven that he established
{17} the calling {18} the hearing. {19} likewise before his Fa{20},
{21} King of {22}, of the Son{23}. They saw him saying:
{24} '{25} am the one who has seen him with my Father;
{26} you. You also: what you have seen
{27} is what you do.'
⟨p.36⟩
The fourth Father is the Mind of Light, the chooser of
all churches. He himself also called three
powers in the likeness of Jesus. The first power is the apostle
of Light, who comes at the time to bear the Church
of flesh of humanity, to be at the head within right-
eousness. The second is the Call which comes to the apo-
stle, to be revealed to him, to become for him a yokefellow,
to attend him in every place, to help him at every time, away
from all afflictions and dangers. The third
is the form of light which the elect and the cat-
echumens receive when they renounce the world.
And the fifth Father also is the form of light which
is revealed to everyone who will {0} forth from the bo-
dy, into the likeness of the icon of the apostle and the {1}
great angels who are glorious, who come with her. The one to {2}
the prize in his right hand. The second comes bearing the garment
of light. The third is the one who holds the diadem
and the wreath and the crown of light. These are the th-
ree angels of light who come with the form
of light, and they are revealed with her to the elect and to the
catechumens. These are the five Fathers who came forth
from one another. They were revealed, they {3} through one an-
other. These are those of him who will recognize them before {4} faces,
so that some attain life forever, to receive these garments of
light which they give to the righteous, {5} of peace,
and the men of mercy.
